fact: On 18 July 2023 Niger's statistics institute announced it was publishing key macroeconomic and financial data through a national summary data page, with a machine-readable data portal on the AfDB open data platform to be published by 30 September 2023.
title: Le Niger adopte le Système Général de Diffusion des Données amélioré (SGDD-a)
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Niger
